# Axioma

Follow `AGENTS.md` and `docs/development-protocol.md`. Product acceptance criteria live in `docs/specs/`. The reusable workflow is `.github/skills/axioma-development/SKILL.md`; read it for feature/release tasks if it is not automatically loaded.

All educational content and interface copy are Romanian. Preserve lesson identities, stored mastery, account isolation, and social access checks. Add meaningful tests during development, update release notes, and commit the authorized change after validation. Repository guidance does not grant permission to push or deploy.
